problem: The flow journal committed in the PR quotes a withheld working-hours phrase and names the team-repository ban, which AC5 and the operator's privacy rule keep out of public text.
impact: A phrase the operator asked not to publish becomes public in the repository and its history.
suggested_fix: Reword the line to say only that some decisions were withheld for privacy and refer to the held-back list; drop the quote and the topic.
evidence: Line 8 listed the withheld working-hours quote and 'the ban on team-repository details' among rows without a findable quote.

class_scope.enumeration_method: keryx ctx rg -n -i --hidden over the flow 402 folder, docs/research/role-blurring-part1 and src/docs for the withheld phrases, plus a read of the PR body

verification.evidence: At e482a187 (fix in fedd3e4a): `keryx ctx rg -n -i --hidden "рабоч|working hour|team-repositor|ban on|process-metrics"` over the flow 402 folder and docs/research/role-blurring-part1 returned only the acceptance-criteria wording, the journal privacy-search command lines and the AC5 update entry; line 8 of journal.md is now a generic note that some decisions were held back, with no withheld quote and no team-repository detail. `bun test src/docs/part1-materials.test.ts` at e482a187 -> 4 pass, 0 fail.

disposition.evidence: fixed in fedd3e4a (flow journal line reworded), verified at e482a187

problem: The export allow-list is imported from the exporter instead of pinned in the test, and values are not type-checked.
impact: A later edit of the exporter widens the test silently, and a string-valued text field under an allowed name would pass.
suggested_fix: Pin the field list literally in the test and check value types.
evidence: import { EXPORT_FIELDS } from '../decisions/export'; only Object.keys were asserted.

verification.evidence: At e482a187 (fixes fedd3e4a, e482a187): src/docs/part1-materials.test.ts pins PINNED_EXPORT_FIELDS (25 names) literally, compares it to EXPORT_FIELDS and checks value types and rating keys; `bun test src/docs/part1-materials.test.ts` -> 4 pass, 0 fail, 3557 expect() calls.

disposition.evidence: fixed in fedd3e4a and e482a187 (test pins export fields and value types)
